title: No loading state and an unstyled 404 in admin
what_happens: There is no loading.tsx, error.tsx or not-found.tsx anywhere under src/app/admin, so clicking a session leaves the old page frozen while the server runs ~8 queries (synthesis loads up to 10,000 points). A bad code shows Next's default black-on-white '404 | This page could not be found' with no admin nav and no link back. Loading itself not captured (from code).
who_hurts: Dane clicking a big session gets no feedback and may click again; someone on an old or renamed session link lands on a dead end.
suggested_fix: Add src/app/admin/sessions/loading.tsx (simple skeleton of the header + cards) and src/app/admin/sessions/[code]/not-found.tsx ('No session called <code>' + link to Sessions), using the existing card styles.
